scope: mechanism checks only; no frozen-model utility conclusions

hypotheses.old: Fixed-bank parent/child single-action values improve whole-rule discovery/adaptation
hypotheses.revised: Measured alternatives expose jointly missed opportunities; remaining-budget labels improve target correspondence

blind_spot_test.caveat: Pass means information is represented accurately and visibly, not that the LLM uses it or whole-rule quality improves.

local_global_test.horizon_alignment: implemented and route-verified; necessary budget correction, not full target equivalence
local_global_test.interpretation: Under fixed common states/labels/weights, changing the scalar reference to the best action cannot create distinctions between rules with equal local values. Rich cases add behavioral information, but do not establish whole-rule credit.

next_decision: Milestone may report partial mechanism repair and unresolved target correspondence; no justification yet for scaling training solely from nonzero case values.
